Special City Council Meeting - technical difficulties DVD available in the City Clerk's Office
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
November 18, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CLOSED SESSION - 4:00 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION*3
CS1.
Conference with legal counsel concerning anticipated litigation - a statement made by a person in an open and public meeting on October 28, 2008, by "policewatch.org," pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (b). (CC)
CALL TO ORDER - OPEN SESSION
Recommended Action:
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE*3
CLOSED SESSION REPORT
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring November 18, 2008, "North Coast Church Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of their weekend of service to the community. (CC)
P2.
Certificates of Appointment to incoming youth commissioners and Certificates of Appreciation to outgoing youth commissioners. (CC)
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C1A.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/CDC/BSD)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending September 30, 2008 (CC)
C4.
Application for Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Modifications and Cabaret License for Dellz California Grill, located at 1233 East Vista Way (CC)
1.
Direct staff to withdraw the City's protest of live entertainment and happy hour, and notify the ABC of such action; and
2.
Approve a Class "B" cabaret license including certain conditions.
C5.
Application for Cabaret License for the Pizza Factory, located at 1910 Shadowridge Drive, Suite #101 (CC)
C6.
Special Event Banner Program for 2008 Calendar Year (CC)
C7.
Federal Legislative Lobbyist Agreement (CC)
C8.
Air Quality Power Generation Mitigation Program Grant Agreement (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , authorizing the City Manager to sign the agreement and any amendments thereto, and accepting grant funds of $112,000 from the County of San Diego; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2008-2009.
C9.
Remove a Portion of a "Passenger Loading" Zone on Valley Drive (CC)
C10.
Foothill Drive Reconstruction Project (CC)
C11.
Environmental Impact Report for the Drainage Master Plan Update (CC)
C12.
Vista Village / Broadway Lighting and Sidewalk Project (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , consenting to the use of tax increment funds by the Community Development Commission to pay for the project; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , awarding a contract with Southland Paving, Inc., for construction of the project.
C13.
Rancho Minerva Design Build Services (CC)
C14.
Community Development Commission 2007-2008 Annual Report (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution 2008- , approving the report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , accepting the 2007-2008 Annual Report of the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista.
C15.
Establishing the Office of City Attorney and City Prosecutor (CC)
C16.
Adopting Updated Rules of Procedures as a Charter City (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing Certain Rules of Procedure";
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Setting the Order of Business for Regular Meetings"; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , Setting the Order of Business for Regular Meetings.
C17.
Construction Management Services Agreement (CC)
C18.
Land Acquisition for the Purchase of 1315 N. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
C19.
Cardiac Monitor Purchase (CC)
C20.
Installation of Diesel Particulate Filters in Select City Vehicles (CC)
C21.
Sewer Engineering Design and Program Management Agreements for As-needed Sanitary Sewer Design Engineering Services (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution 2008- , approving an agreement with Boyle Engineering;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Post, Buckley, Shuh, & Jernigan, Inc. (PBS&J);
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Tran Consulting Engineers;
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an agreement with Dudek & Associates, Inc. for sewer Capital Improvement Program management services; and authorizing the Mayor to execute all agreements.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Public Arts Commission - Sprinter Corridor Murals (CC)
D2.
Sports Park Construction Contract (CC)
D3.
Fiscal Year 2007-2008 Fourth Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report; and
2.
Provide direction to staff on the recommended use of year-end fund balance.
D4.
Fiscal Year 2008-2009 First Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2008/09;
3.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2008/09; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Promenade Circle Specific Plan Amendment - City of Vista, Community Development, Applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the Specific Plan Amendment; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- . approving an amendment to Specific Plan 4 to amend the development standards governing projections into rear and side yards for sixteen (16) parcels located on the east side of Promenade Circle.
PH2.
Regional Transportation Improvement Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public comment; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , adopting an amendment of the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2009 through 2013.
PH3.
Appeal of PC8-203, Recreational Vehicle and Boat Storage Yard, Liberty Family Partnership, Arie DeJong, Applicant (CC)
PH2.
Regional Transportation Improvement Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public comment; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , adopting an amendment of the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2009 through 2013.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
